title: W-6: an informational HTTP response (100, 103) is recorded as the final result
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-6 (medium). The reader returns the first header block and accepts any three-digit status, so a 103 Early Hints before the real answer is recorded as a failure; for a delivered POST or DELETE a retrying caller can duplicate the action. Files: src/adapters/https-transport.ts, src/application/run.ts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Bounded informational responses are consumed until a final status arrives, with limits over the whole exchange
A missing final response after delivery is reported as indeterminate
Tests cover 100 and 103 followed by success, and split and coalesced chunks
